svg.aria-label: The collector cut open, drawn: three controllers feed three ports on the left wall; inside, the driver bay, the bench with its three dials, the watchman's screen under an orange beacon, the safe of eight plates, the order desk with its violet line, the spare control room's green screen with a lock, the log cards; two delivery tubes out through the back wall to the server and the history stack, cut for a third of every cycle while the safe brightens and the lock opens; two green tubes out of the open front to the plant's own screens
